description_short: Test pack exercising the 0.3.0 recipe split (build_recipe + bind_recipe + with-form).
description_long: Not a content mod — a load-time test pack for the CustomAssets 0.3.0 recipe API. Registers four throwaway recipes over vanilla products/machines that exercise: the `with build_recipe(...) as r:` context form binding one recipe to two machines with different durations and a throughput multiplier; the `with` form without an `as` clause; the explicit machine-less build_recipe + bind_recipe pair; automatic output-port distribution for a recipe with several same-type (fluid) outputs; and the legacy one-shot build_recipe(machine=...) form. If the pack loads with no errors, all five paths work.
